info.name: School API — School Teachers
info.description:
Campus director teacher roster + teacher first-login password. **Documented:** `GET|POST /school-teachers`, `POST /school-teachers/password`, `POST /school-teachers/:id/resend-credentials`.

- Host: `{{schoolHost}}`. App / admin / apex → 403 `Campus login is only allowed on that school's host` (not the app-host 403 text).
- **Host is checked before the token** (unlike `/admin/*`). Missing token on the app host is 403, not 401.
- List / create / resend: director `{{campusAccessToken}}`. Teacher-kind token → 403 `Only the school director can manage teachers`.
- Password: teacher `{{teacherAccessToken}}` from campus sign-in with `{{teacherEmail}}` / `{{teacherPassword}}`. Director token → 403 `Only a teacher can change this password`.
- Inactive / suspended / pending_setup → 403 `This school account is not active` (not `This school account is suspended`).
- Create 409 and tenant-invite 409 share `This email cannot be used.`. Resend 409 is `Credentials cannot be resent after the password is changed`.
- `GET /admin/dashboard` is not this collection.

Shared environment: `environments/School-API.local.postman_environment.json`.

- `{{baseUrl}}` is the **backend** (`http://127.0.0.1:5000`), not Next on `3000`.
- Prefer `x-school-host` over `Host`. Matching lowercases and strips `:{port}`.
- Tokens are HMAC (`payload.signature`), not JWT. Admin `{{accessToken}}` will not verify on school/campus routes (different HMAC material). School and campus share `:school-account-session`.
- Error JSON (except health): `{ "error": "<string>" }`. No 422. Wrapper-only 500 is `{ "error": "Internal server error" }`.
- Do not invent routes or status codes. Later batches land in the matching collection file — do not grow a monolith.

item.name: School Teachers
item.description:
Teacher roster on `{slug}.{{rootHost}}` (`{{schoolHost}}`). Sign in the director via **Campus Session** first (`{{campusAccessToken}}`). Create writes `{{teacherId}}` / `{{teacherEmail}}` / `{{teacherPassword}}`. Then **Campus Session → Sign in campus account** with the teacher email writes a teacher-kind token — copy it to `{{teacherAccessToken}}` (do not overwrite the director `{{campusAccessToken}}`).

**This collection:** list newest-first, create + email temp password, teacher first-login password change, resend credentials while `mustChangePassword` is true.

`GET /admin/dashboard` is not documented here.

header.description: HMAC campus session from POST `/school-accounts/campus-session` as the **director** (`kind: "director"`). Same HMAC family as `{{schoolAccessToken}}` (`:school-account-session`). Admin `{{accessToken}}` will not verify (401). Teacher-kind `{{teacherAccessToken}}` → 403 director-only. Missing / empty / invalid / expired → 401 on a campus host. Host is checked first: missing token on the **app** host is 403, not 401.

**Required campus host.** `{slug}.{{rootHost}}` after port strip (e.g. `north-ridge.e-school.et:3000`). `rejectIfNotCampusHost` runs **before** the token. App / admin / apex / reserved labels (`www` `api` `app` `admin` `mail` `ftp`) / empty Host → `403 { "error": "Campus login is only allowed on that school's host" }`. **Not** the app-host 403 text (`School accounts are only allowed on the app host`).

request.description:
Lists teachers on **this campus** newest-first for the signed-in **director**.

**Auth:** required. `Authorization: Bearer {{campusAccessToken}}` from `POST /school-accounts/campus-session` (`kind: "director"`). `authorizeCampusDirector` → `authorizeCampusSession`. `readBearerToken` only accepts a header that starts with `Bearer `.

**Host first (unlike admin routes):** `rejectIfNotCampusHost` runs **before** the token. App / admin / apex / reserved / empty → `403 { "error": "Campus login is only allowed on that school's host" }`. A campus-shaped host whose slug is not in the directory is **401** after a token is present (or 401 if the token is missing — host already passed). A **valid** other-school campus host with this director token is **401** (`accountId !== tenant.id`), not 403.

**Who:** the campus director. `kind: "teacher"` → `403 { "error": "Only the school director can manage teachers" }`. Legacy campus cookies without `kind` are treated as the director. Platform admin HMAC → 401. A still-valid `{{schoolAccessToken}}` with the same `accountId` as the tenant also verifies (same `:school-account-session` material) — prefer `{{campusAccessToken}}`.

**Tenant must be `active`.** `pending_setup` and `suspended` → `403 { "error": "This school account is not active" }` (not `This school account is suspended`).

**Side effects:** `teachers.ensureSchema(slug)` then `listNewestFirst`. Empty roster is still **200** `{ "teachers": [] }`.

**Success `200`:** `{ teachers }` — each row is the teacher admin view: `{ id, givenName, fatherName, grandfatherName, displayName, sex, phone, email, employeeId, mustChangePassword, lastMailAt, lastMailOk, lastMailError, signedInAt, createdAt }`. `displayName` is `givenName fatherName grandfatherName`. `phone` is E.164 (`+251…`). `employeeId` / mail / `signedInAt` may be `null`. ISO-8601 for dates. Newest `createdAt` first. Test script writes `{{teacherId}}` / `{{teacherEmail}}` from `teachers[0]` when present.

**Same path as POST create.** `405` is PUT/PATCH/DELETE only. A POST without a body is **create**, not 405. Trailing slash `/school-teachers/` does not match — generic `404 { "error": "Not found" }`.

**Errors that exist:** 401 Unauthorized; 403 campus-host / director-only / inactive; 405 other methods; 404 only for a non-matching path (trailing slash).

**Not used:** 400, 409, 422. No distinct 500 from this handler. `GET /admin/dashboard` is not this collection.

request.description:
Creates a teacher on **this campus** and emails a temporary password.

**Auth / host / who:** same as GET list — campus director, host first. Teacher session → `403 { "error": "Only the school director can manage teachers" }`. Inactive school → `403 { "error": "This school account is not active" }`.

**Body:** `{ givenName, fatherName, grandfatherName, sex, phone, email, employeeId? }`. Non-string or missing keys become `""` (not 400-for-missing-key). Non-object JSON (`[]`, `"x"`) is treated as `{}`. Empty body / `{}` is valid JSON then fails **Given name is required**. `employeeId` omitted or blank after trim → `null` (optional).

**Validate in this order** (first failure wins):
- `givenName` / `fatherName` / `grandfatherName` — trim + collapse spaces. Empty → `{Label} is required`. Over **80** → `{Label} is too long`. Labels: `Given name`, `Father name`, `Grandfather name`.
- `sex` — exactly `male` or `female` (case-sensitive; `Male` fails) → `Sex must be male or female`.
- `phone` — trim empty → `Phone is required`. Else Ethiopian mobile (`09…`/`07…` 10-digit, `9…`/`7…` 9-digit, or `+2519…`/`+2517…`) or `A valid Ethiopian mobile number is required`. Stored as `+251…`. Landlines (`011…`) fail.
- `email` — trim + lowercase. Empty → `Email is required`. Must match `[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+` or `A valid email is required`.
- `employeeId` — trim; over **64** → `Employee id is too long`.

**409 always the same text:** `{ "error": "This email cannot be used." }` for the platform-admin email (case-insensitive), the director tenant email, an existing teacher email on this slug, or an insert race. The body never says which. No mail is sent on 409.

**Side effects:** generates a temp password, inserts the teacher (`mustChangePassword` true), emails campus login credentials (`http://{slug}.{rootHost}:3000/login?email=…`). Mailer failure still **201** — `emailSent: false` and `emailError` are set; `teacher.lastMailOk` / `lastMailError` record the attempt.

**Success `201`:** `{ teacher, credentials: { email, password, loginUrl }, emailSent, emailError? }`. `teacher` is the admin view. `loginUrl` is **not** `firstLoginUrl`. Test script writes `{{teacherId}}`, `{{teacherEmail}}`, and `{{teacherPassword}}` from the body.

**Same path as GET.** `405` is PUT/PATCH/DELETE only.

**Errors that exist:** 400 Invalid JSON / field validation; 401 Unauthorized; 403 campus-host / director-only / inactive; 409 email cannot be used; 405 other methods.

**Not used:** 404 (path exists), 422. No distinct 500 from this handler.

request.description:
First-login password change for a **teacher** on the campus host. Directors cannot use this path.

**Auth:** required. `Authorization: Bearer {{teacherAccessToken}}` from `POST /school-accounts/campus-session` with the teacher email / temp password (`kind: "teacher"`). `authorizeCampusTeacher`.

**Host first:** same campus-host rule as list/create. App / admin / apex → `403 { "error": "Campus login is only allowed on that school's host" }`.

**Who:** a teacher whose `mustChangePassword` is still true. Director `{campusAccessToken}` → `403 { "error": "Only a teacher can change this password" }`. Teacher id missing from the tenant schema → 401 Unauthorized. Inactive school → `403 { "error": "This school account is not active" }`.

**Body:** `{ password }` only — **not** `currentPassword` / `newPassword`. Non-string or missing → `""`. Empty body `{}` is valid JSON then fails length (if still in first-login).

**Order after auth:** `mustChangePassword === false` is checked **before** password rules → `409 { "error": "Password has already been changed" }` even if `password` is short. Then length **12** → `Password must be at least 12 characters`. Then hasher.verify against the current hash → `New password must be different from the current password`. `updatePassword` miss → 401 Unauthorized.

**Side effects:** hashes the new password and sets `mustChangePassword` false. Does **not** rotate the session token.

**Success `200`:** `{ teacher }` — admin view with `mustChangePassword: false`. No `token` / `credentials` field.

**After success, resend-credentials for this id is 409.** Sign in again via **Campus Session** with the new password to refresh `{{teacherAccessToken}}` if needed.

**Errors that exist:** 400 Invalid JSON / length / same-as-current; 401 Unauthorized; 403 campus-host / teacher-only / inactive; 409 already changed; 405 GET/PUT/PATCH/DELETE.

**Not used:** 404 (path exists), 422. No distinct 500 from this handler.

request.description:
Resets the temp password and re-emails campus login credentials **only while** `mustChangePassword` is true.

**Auth / host / who:** same as GET list / POST create — campus director, host first. Teacher session → `403 { "error": "Only the school director can manage teachers" }`.

**No body.** The handler does not call `readJsonBody`. There is no `400 Invalid JSON` on this path.

**Id:** `readSchoolTeacherResend` — `/school-teachers/{id}/resend-credentials`. `id` must be a non-empty segment with no `/`. Empty id or extra path does **not** match → generic `404 { "error": "Not found" }` (catch-all). Matched then `isTeacherId` (UUID, any version, case-insensitive) fails or `findAuthById` misses → `404 { "error": "Teacher not found" }`. No 400 for a bad id. `GET /school-teachers/{id}` (no suffix) is also generic 404.

**409 after first-login completes:** `{ "error": "Credentials cannot be resent after the password is changed" }`. This is **not** `Password has already been changed` (that string is only POST `/school-teachers/password`).

**Side effects:** generates a new temp password, keeps `mustChangePassword` true, emails the same campus `loginUrl` shape as create. Mailer failure still **200** with `emailSent: false` and `emailError`. Test script writes `{{teacherPassword}}` from `credentials.password` on 200.

**Success `200`:** `{ teacher, credentials: { email, password, loginUrl }, emailSent, emailError? }`.

**`/school-teachers/password` is checked first.** `POST /school-teachers/password/resend-credentials` matches this handler with `id=password` → 404 Teacher not found (after auth).

**Errors that exist:** 401 Unauthorized; 403 campus-host / director-only / inactive; 404 Teacher not found / generic Not found; 409 resend locked; 405 GET/PUT/PATCH/DELETE.

**Not used:** 400, 422. No distinct 500 from this handler.

Empty or extra `/` does not match (generic 404 Not found). `isTeacherId` is UUID (any version, case-insensitive). Non-UUID and unknown id → 404 Teacher not found (no 400).
